crossRefs.note: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred…
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
Yahweh’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit…
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment…
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum; sweet spices with pure…
The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one…
Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…
Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever…
Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add…
The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.
Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.

translations.web: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
translations.bsb: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
translations.kjv: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
translations.asv: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
